# University of Technology Sydney — Gentle / Smith

## Why it matters internationally

Gentle and Smith demonstrated sub-ambient daytime radiative cooling on
real roofs before the field's current boom, anchoring the
Southern-Hemisphere presence of engineered emissivity and its building
applications.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** spectrally selective surfaces · sub-ambient radiative cooling performance
- **Spectral range:** solar + 8–13 µm sky window
- **Temperature:** field demonstrations (roof scale)
- **Methodology:** Pioneering sub-ambient daytime radiative cooling roof demonstrations (coated polymer stack on silver absorbing ~3% solar while strongly emitting in the sky window); spectrally selective surfaces for buildings.

**Application domains:** cool roofs and buildings · spectrally selective surfaces.
